description: depgraph settings at the scanned root, or of a directory below it (a package of a monorepo: its layers, forbidden, components, ignore and unused-code paths are relative to that directory). Every key is optional; unknown keys, rules, options and layer names are errors.

abstract.description: Layer -> layers it may use only through interfaces (imports stay allowed): holding or building an implementation of one although an interface it implements exists (concrete-dependency), or exposing its concrete types in the layer's API (type-leak), is reported. Names must be defined in layers (or be default layers).

Layer -> layers it may use only through interfaces (imports stay allowed): holding or building an implementation of one although an interface it implements exists (concrete-dependency), or exposing its concrete types in the layer's API (type-leak), is reported. Names must be defined in layers (or be default layers). Within one component directory.

forbidden.description: Layer -> layers it must not import, within one component directory. Names must be defined in layers (or be default layers).

languages.description: Language -> the version it runs in the component's directory. The setting of the deepest directory holding a file applies.

python.description: The version this part of the project runs, to classify its imports (standard library or third-party) for ext: wildcards. Name the file that pins it (recommended) or the version.

stdlib.description: A typeshed stdlib directory (with its VERSIONS file), relative to the component's directory; default: the copies in node_modules (pyright, basedpyright).

version.description: The version itself (3.12), when no file pins it.

versionFile.description: The file that pins the version, relative to the component's directory (recommended): .python-version, .tool-versions, mise.toml, pyproject.toml ([tool.pyright] pythonVersion / [tool.mypy] python_version), pyrightconfig.json, Dockerfile. It may be a symlink.

layers.description: Layer name -> package patterns: path globs (path segments; ** any number of segments); ext:<name> for an external package and what is under it (ext:gorm.io/gorm, ext:net/http: the standard library too); ext:<pattern> with * / ? for third-party packages (ext:* is every one, never the standard library); !<pattern> leaves packages out ("!ext:github.com/google/uuid"). Package globs are relative to the component's directory. Replaces the default layers and their forbidden pairs.

components.description: Parts of a monorepo with layers of their own: directory (relative to this file) or a pattern over directories (packages/*: one component per directory, * and ? but no **) -> its layers and forbidden pairs, with package globs relative to that directory. The default layers are not applied inside a component; layers declared at the root apply everywhere. A directory's own .depgraph.yml does the same.

forbidden.description: Layer -> layers it must not import. Names must be defined in layers (or be default layers).

ignore.description: Package globs excluded from every rule (they are still scanned and shown in the UI).

languages.description: Language -> the version it runs in this file's directory. The setting of the deepest directory holding a file applies.

python.description: The version this part of the project runs, to classify its imports (standard library or third-party) for ext: wildcards. Name the file that pins it (recommended) or the version.

stdlib.description: A typeshed stdlib directory (with its VERSIONS file), relative to this file's directory; default: the copies in node_modules (pyright, basedpyright).

version.description: The version itself (3.12), when no file pins it.

versionFile.description: The file that pins the version, relative to this file's directory (recommended): .python-version, .tool-versions, mise.toml, pyproject.toml ([tool.pyright] pythonVersion / [tool.mypy] python_version), pyrightconfig.json, Dockerfile. It may be a symlink.

layers.description: Layer name -> package patterns: path globs (path segments; ** any number of segments); ext:<name> for an external package and what is under it (ext:gorm.io/gorm, ext:net/http: the standard library too); ext:<pattern> with * / ? for third-party packages (ext:* is every one, never the standard library); !<pattern> leaves packages out ("!ext:github.com/google/uuid"). Replaces the default layers and their forbidden pairs.

project.description: Project key in the database (default: the directory name of the root; @<worktree> is added in a linked git worktree).

rules.description: Per rule: enabled, severity and the rule's options.

concrete-dependency.description: a struct / class holds or builds an implementation of a layer it must use through an interface (abstract:), although an interface it implements exists

duplicate-code.description: the same logic in several places, whatever the names

minTokens.description: Bodies with fewer syntax tokens are not compared.

similarity.description: Minimum Jaccard similarity of the bodies' fingerprints (1: the same shape).

duplicate-symbol.description: an exported function / class declared in several files

ignore.description: Symbol names never reported (replaces the defaults): an exact name, a prefix such as Test*, or a glob where * is any run of characters and ? one character.

external-unclassified.description: external imports an ext:* layer pattern could not classify (third-party or not), listed instead of dropped

file-cycle.description: import cycle between the files of one directory (TypeScript / JavaScript, Python)

deferred.description: Also report the cycles that only close through an import inside a function (Python): a deferred import hides a cycle, it does not remove it.

function-cycle.description: functions in different files of a Go package that call each other in a cycle

god-package.description: a hub: imported by many packages and importing many

fanIn.description: Report a package imported by at least this many packages (and importing at least fanOut).

fanOut.description: Report only packages that also import at least this many packages of the repository: a widely used package that depends on nothing is stable, not a god package.

layer-violation.description: a package imports a layer it must not import

low-cohesion.description: a package / module whose parts nothing inside connects are used by different code: more than one responsibility

module-cycle.description: import cycle between the modules of a monorepo (Go modules, npm packages, Python projects, Ruby gems / packwerk packs, components)

pass-through.description: a chain of two or more functions that only pass their parameters on to the next

type-leak.description: the API of a layer exposes a concrete type or data of a layer it must use only through an interface (abstract:)

unreachable-file.description: a TS/JS/Python/Ruby file no entry point reaches

entries.description: Path globs of entry points depgraph cannot see (plugins loaded by name, files an external tool runs). Shared by unused-export, unreachable-file and unreachable-package.

ignore.description: Path globs (files and Go package directories) never reported, e.g. a library's public API. Shared by unused-export, unreachable-file and unreachable-package.

unreachable-package.description: a Go package no entry point reaches

entries.description: Path globs of entry points depgraph cannot see (plugins loaded by name, files an external tool runs). Shared by unused-export, unreachable-file and unreachable-package.

ignore.description: Path globs (files and Go package directories) never reported, e.g. a library's public API. Shared by unused-export, unreachable-file and unreachable-package.

unused-dependency.description: a dependency a manifest declares that nothing imports or names (error when certain, a level lower when a use that is not an import cannot be ruled out)

ignore.description: Dependencies never reported (used in a way nothing in the repository shows). A name: exact, or a glob where * is any run of characters and ? one character ("@types/*"). For one language only: "go:", "javascript:", "python:" or "ruby:" before the name ("ruby:pg", "python:*"). For one manifest only: its path, as a path glob, and a colon before the name ("web/package.json:lodash", "services/**/requirements.txt:*"); both: "ruby:engines/**/Gemfile:pg". In the .depgraph.yml of a directory below the root, the entries apply to the manifests in and below that directory and manifest paths are relative to it.

unused-export.description: an exported declaration nothing in the project uses

entries.description: Path globs of entry points depgraph cannot see (plugins loaded by name, files an external tool runs). Shared by unused-export, unreachable-file and unreachable-package.

ignore.description: Path globs (files and Go package directories) never reported, e.g. a library's public API. Shared by unused-export, unreachable-file and unreachable-package.

wide-function.description: a function that calls functions of more than maxPackages packages of the repository

maxPackages.description: Report a function that calls functions of more than this many packages of the repository (its own not counted).

store.description: How Neo4j is provided. Flags and environment variables take precedence.

containerCli.description: Container CLI of the container provider: docker, podman, nerdctl or a path (default: the first that answers).

persist.description: Keep the container provider's data in a named volume across runs.

provider.description: external: the Neo4j of --neo4j / $NEO4J_URI; container: depgraph runs one (default when no URI is set).
